title: Probe (test-only): PG R_vp at init — α ∈ {0.20,0.33}, head=48 (PG recipe)
abstract: Compute initial trunk gradient ratio R_vp = ||∇_trunk L_value|| / ||∇_trunk L_policy|| for PG with RIN α ∈ {0.20,0.33} and head_hidden=48 (PG SOTA setting). Reports norms and R_vp to STDOUT.

original_submission.content:
import jax, jax.numpy as jnp
from typing import Optional, Dict
import flax.linen as nn
from flax import traverse_util

class BottleneckDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int; bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28; dilation: int = 6
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        mid = max(1, int(self.features * self.bottleneck_ratio))
        y = nn.Conv(mid,(1,1),padding='SAME')(x); y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(mid,(3,3),padding='SAME',kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,self.dilation))(y); y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(self.features,(1,1),padding='SAME')(y)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    features: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        gates = nn.Conv(4*self.features,(3,3),padding='SAME')(jnp.concatenate([x,h],axis=-1))
        gates = nn.LayerNorm(epsilon=1e-5)(gates)
        i,f,g,o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)
        i = nn.sigmoid(i); f = nn.sigmoid(f); o = nn.sigmoid(o); g = jnp.tanh(g)
        c = f*c + i*g
        h = o*jnp.tanh(c)
        return (h,c), h

class NetRIN_AttnGap(nn.Module):
    rin_alpha: float = 0.33
    cnn_features_1: int = 32; cnn_features_2: int = 64
    convlstm_features: int = 64; dilation: int = 6; bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28
    head_hidden: int = 48; steps: int = 4
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray):
        B = x.shape[0]
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_1, self.bottleneck_ratio, self.dilation)(x)
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_2, self.bottleneck_ratio, self.dilation)(x)
        x_ln = nn.LayerNorm(epsilon=1e-5)(x)
        x = x + self.rin_alpha * (x_ln - x)
        zeros = lambda: jnp.zeros((B,8,8,self.convlstm_features), dtype=x.dtype)
        h, c = zeros(), zeros()
        for _ in range(self.steps):
            (h,c), _ = ConvLSTMCellLN(self.convlstm_features)((h,c), x)
        B_,H,W,C = h.shape
        attn_logits = nn.Conv(1,(1,1),padding='SAME')(h).reshape((B_,H*W))
        attn_w = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=-1).reshape((B_,H*W,1))
        tokens = h.reshape((B_,H*W,C))
        attn_vec = (attn_w * tokens).sum(axis=1)
        gap_vec = tokens.mean(axis=1)
        z = jnp.concatenate([attn_vec, gap_vec], axis=-1)
        shared = nn.Dense(256)(z); shared = nn.relu(shared)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.head_hidden)(shared); ph = nn.relu(ph)
        policy = nn.Dense(4)(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.head_hidden)(shared); vh = nn.relu(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1)(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy, value

def _flatten(tree): return traverse_util.flatten_dict(tree, keep_empty_nodes=True)
def _unflatten(fd): return traverse_util.unflatten_dict(fd)
def _mask_trunk(params):
    flat = _flatten(params)
    mask = {}
    for k in flat.keys():
        path = "/".join(k)
        # Treat any Dense layers as heads; everything else = trunk
        mask[k] = ("Dense" not in path)
    return _unflatten(mask)

def _masked_norm(grads, mask):
    fg, fm = _flatten(grads), _flatten(mask)
    sq = 0.0
    for k,g in fg.items():
        if fm.get(k, False):
            sq = sq + jnp.sum(jnp.square(g))
    return float(jnp.sqrt(sq + 1e-12))

def test():
    key = jax.random.PRNGKey(0)
    B = 16
    obs = jax.random.normal(key, (B,8,8,8))
    done = jnp.zeros((B,), dtype=jnp.bool_)
    key, ka, kr = jax.random.split(key, 3)
    advantages = jax.random.normal(ka, (B,))
    actions = jax.random.randint(kr, (B,), 0, 4)
    returns_target = jnp.zeros((B,))  # baseline target for value MSE at init

    def pg_policy_loss(params, net):
        logits, _ = net.apply(params, obs, done)
        logp = jax.nn.log_softmax(logits, axis=-1)[jnp.arange(B), actions]
        return -jnp.mean(jax.lax.stop_gradient(advantages) * logp)

    def pg_value_loss(params, net):
        _, v = net.apply(params, obs, done)
        return 0.5 * jnp.mean((v - jax.lax.stop_gradient(returns_target))**2)

    results = []
    for alpha in [0.20, 0.33]:
        net = NetRIN_AttnGap(rin_alpha=alpha, head_hidden=48)
        params = net.init(key, obs, done)
        mask = _mask_trunk(params)
        g_pi = jax.grad(lambda p: pg_policy_loss(p, net))(params)
        g_v  = jax.grad(lambda p: pg_value_loss(p, net))(params)
        n_pi = _masked_norm(g_pi, mask)
        n_v  = _masked_norm(g_v, mask)
        r_vp = n_v / (n_pi + 1e-12)
        results.append({"alpha": alpha, "norm_trunk_policy": n_pi, "norm_trunk_value": n_v, "R_vp": r_vp})

    print("PG R_vp at init (head=48) over alpha:")
    for r in results:
        print(f"alpha={r['alpha']:.2f} | ||g_pi||={r['norm_trunk_policy']:.4f}, ||g_v||={r['norm_trunk_value']:.4f}, R_vp={r['R_vp']:.4f}")
    return {"results": results}
